title: Radiant Courtyard
text: Look for a circular courtyard on a crystal island high in the Dawn Crystal Plains, marked by crystal columns and Light Crystal Torches. Its eight column positions may be intact, broken or fallen. Prepare safe travel and a way home.
Its single loot Crystal Ball holds crystal supplies and torches, with a chance of Light or Dark Microcores, an Arcane Crystal Grid or a Dream Spell Core.
